text:
maria: after the 00:10 privnet audit-rule deploy, several GPU nodes in eu-west-2/ap-south fail at bootstrap with 'kms:AccessDenied' during keystore decrypt.
jon: confirming, nodes stuck at 'decrypting keystore' in agent logs.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-4822 created and paged.
ashley (security): I swapped alias alias/privnet-keystore -> alias/privnet-keystore-v2 during the rollout and rotated grants; I only created the new key in us-west-2 initially.
liam: that explains regional AccessDenied. eu/ap nodes hit alias pointing to a key with no regional grants.
maria: mitigation options? revert alias in eu/ap or replicate key + grants.
nashley (security): I'll revert alias in eu-west-2 and ap-south and add grants for svc-gpu-keystore in those regions. ETA ~10m.
maria: doing alias revert in eu-west-2 now, then restarting gpu-keystore DaemonSet.
ops-oncall: watch NATGW metrics in ap-south; we saw a conn count spike during mass decrypts which may cause post-decrypt connectivity failures.
jon: added stagger/restart jitter in runbook and limited parallelism to 2 pods/az to avoid NATGW bursts.
sre-bot: auto-check: nodes recovered after revert in eu-west-2, 9/12 booted.
ashley (security): post-mitigation: creating preflight checklist and CI gate that verifies key ARNs and grants exist in all active regions before alias swaps.
billing: note KMS replication + NATGW scaling costs; ops please close replication window after verification.
maria: owners for postmortem: maria, jon, ashley. Drafting timeline and remediation steps. Closing thread after postmortem doc created.
